story_fr: Boston Scientific affiche un CA de 5,2 Mds USD au T1 2026, en hausse organique de 9,4%, au-dessus de la fourchette guidee par la direction (8,5-10%).
story_en: Boston Scientific reports Q1 2026 net sales of $5.2B, up 9.4% organically, above the high end of its guided range of 8.5-10%.
quote: net sales of $5.203 billion...9.4 percent on an organic basis, compared to the company's guidance range of 8.5 to 10.0 percent

story_fr: L'etude CHAMPION-AF confirme que le WATCHMAN FLX est superieur aux anticoagulants oraux pour reduire le risque d'AVC chez les patients en FA non valvulaire.
story_en: The CHAMPION-AF trial confirms WATCHMAN FLX superiority over oral anticoagulants for stroke risk reduction in non-valvular atrial fibrillation patients.
signal: WATCHMAN FLX superieur aux anticoagulants oraux
quote: CHAMPION-AF study...met all primary and secondary endpoints and demonstrated superior bleeding risk reduction

story_fr: L'etude ADVENT a 4 ans confirme la superiorite durable de FARAPULSE face aux ablations thermiques, avec moins de reinterventions et d'arythmies hospitalisees.
story_en: The ADVENT 4-year long-term outcomes study confirms FARAPULSE's durable superiority over thermal ablation, with fewer repeat ablations and hospital arrhythmia events.
signal: FARAPULSE superieur a long terme vs ablation thermique
quote: ADVENT Long-Term Outcomes...demonstrated greater long-term AF treatment success...at four years with FARAPULSE

story_fr: Boston Scientific franchit 20 Mds USD de CA en 2025 (+19,9%), avec un BPA ajuste de 3,06 USD en hausse de 22% sur un an, une annee record pour le groupe.
story_en: Boston Scientific crosses $20B in FY 2025 revenue (+19.9%), with adjusted EPS of $3.06 up 22% year-over-year, marking a record year for the company.
signal: CA annuel record a 20 Mds USD en 2025
quote: full year 2025...net sales of $20.074 billion, growing 19.9 percent...adjusted EPS $3.06 versus $2.51

story_fr: L'etude HI-PEITHO demontre la superiorite du systeme EKOS sur l'anticoagulation seule pour traiter l'embolie pulmonaire a risque intermediaire, ouvrant un nouveau marche.
story_en: The HI-PEITHO trial demonstrates EKOS system superiority over anticoagulation alone for intermediate-risk pulmonary embolism, opening a new addressable market.
signal: EKOS superieur pour embolie pulmonaire intermediaire
quote: HI-PEITHO clinical trial...demonstrated the EKOS system plus anticoagulation was superior to anticoagulation alone

story_fr: Le segment Cardiovascular de BSX progresse de +13,5% au T1 2026, tire par la cardiologie interventionnelle et les nouvelles plateformes d'electrophysiologie.
story_en: BSX Cardiovascular segment grows +13.5% in Q1 2026, driven by interventional cardiology and new electrophysiology platforms.
